name: J.Enchante
description: J.Enchante is a Fort Myers braiding studio specialising in knotless and box braids, designer feed-ins, Fulani braids, twists, and loc care — neat parts, clean work, and styles that last.

hero.title: Braided to perfection.
hero.subtitle: Knotless braids, designer feed-ins, twists, and loc care in Fort Myers — book your next style today.

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder & Lead Braider
stylists.bio: Founder of J.Enchante, bringing precision parts, clean edges, and creative designer feed-ins to every client in Fort Myers. Every style is done with care so you leave feeling enchanted.

reviews.name: Destiny H.
reviews.text: My knotless braids are so neat and light! The parts are perfect and they didn't hurt at all. Definitely my new braider.

reviews.name: Kiara B.
reviews.text: Got the stitch braid ponytail for my daughter and she loved it. Clean work, fair prices, and so patient with her.

reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.text: Retwist and style came out crisp. Professional, on time, and my locs have never looked healthier.

reviews.name: Janae P.
reviews.text: The feed-in design was even better than the picture I showed her. Best braider in Fort Myers, hands down.
